events.description: A tense standoff between riot police in full protective gear and an opposing group, with two armored police vans positioned as barriers on a narrow street; debris is scattered on the wet pavement, and the scene shows sustained collective unrest with no clear resolution during the interval.

A violent clash erupts between a group of protesters (including individuals in yellow vests) and police/riot officers in front of a Montblanc store; participants are seen shoving, grappling, and throwing objects, with chaotic movement and physical confrontation evident.

Mutual physical combat occurs between multiple individuals: one person in a grey jacket and orange armband lunges and strikes at others, while individuals in yellow vests engage in close-quarters grappling and pushing; actions are reciprocal and aggressive.

Multiple individuals engage in mutual physical combat: a person in a blue hooded jacket and another in a brown jacket with orange armband are seen striking each other; others in yellow vests and black clothing join the melee, with punches and grappling visible across frames.

Sustained violent group clash between protesters (including yellow-vested individuals) and riot police (in helmets and body armor), involving pushing, shoving, throwing, and use of batons near armored vehicles; crowd density and aggressive postures indicate collective violent unrest.

A person in a black jacket and helmet appears to strike or push a person in a yellow vest who is on the ground or in a vulnerable posture (partially obscured but consistent with being overwhelmed by multiple assailants); context suggests targeted aggression against a less-protected individual during the melee.

events.description: Sustained violent clash between riot police in full protective gear (helmets, shields, body armor) and protesters, many wearing yellow vests; involves pushing, shoving, use of batons/shields, and rapid movement across the street; consistent with a large-scale public disorder event.

Direct physical engagement: a protester in a yellow vest raises an object while being confronted by multiple officers; close contact observed with officers using shields to push back, indicating mutual combat.

Intensified hand-to-hand and shield-to-body contact: officers advance aggressively while protesters resist; visible grappling, baton use (e.g., frame f4 shows officer swinging baton), and dynamic struggle across frames.

A protester in a yellow vest appears momentarily isolated and off-balance while being approached by multiple officers; one officer appears to strike or shove him while he is not actively resisting—suggestive of targeting a vulnerable individual.

A violent clash between police in riot gear (helmets, shields, batons) and protesters, many wearing yellow vests, on a city street. The confrontation includes physical pushing, use of shields to advance, and individuals being restrained or on the ground amid dense crowd movement.

At least one individual in a yellow vest is on the ground while multiple officers surround and appear to subdue them; the person on the ground shows no active resistance and is being handled by several officers, consistent with abuse of a helpless victim.

Direct physical engagement between a yellow-vested protester and an officer: the protester appears to be grabbing or striking while the officer pushes back; mutual combat is visible in close proximity.

Large crowd of individuals wearing yellow vests engaged in collective unrest in an urban square; visible smoke or tear gas dispersing across the scene, with groups moving dynamically and some apparent clashes near the center crosswalk and building entrances.
Large crowd of people wearing yellow vests gathered in a city square, with dense smoke or tear gas filling the air; movement suggests unrest and confrontation, consistent with a riot scenario.
Line of riot police in full protective gear (helmets, shields) forming a barrier on a street; visible tension and proximity to protesters indicate active riot control during ongoing unrest.

Armed riot police in full protective gear (helmets, face shields, body armor) are positioned against a building wall, holding what appear to be less-lethal launchers (e.g., tear gas or rubber bullet launchers), aiming toward individuals crouched on the ground nearby. The scene shows a tense standoff consistent with crowd control during civil unrest.

Police officers aim less-lethal weapons directly at individuals who are crouched or seated on the ground against a wall, appearing non-threatening and unable to flee—suggesting potential abuse of force against a helpless group.

Armed riot police in full protective gear (helmets, face shields, body armor) are positioned against a building corner, aiming non-lethal launchers (likely tear gas or rubber bullet launchers) at a group of civilians crouched against the wall. The civilians appear to be protesters taking cover; one wears an orange beanie and backpack, others are seated or kneeling with hands visible or raised. The scene shows a tense standoff characteristic of a riot situation, with police using forceful crowd control measures.

A civilian wearing an orange beanie is seen crouching low against the wall while police continue to aim their launchers directly at them and other seated individuals. The civilians are in a vulnerable, non-threatening posture (crouching, sitting, hands visible), and the sustained aiming by armed officers constitutes abuse of power against a helpless group.
